title: Your coffee order is a personality diagnosis
dek: No barista knowledge required. Twelve questions about how you take it, where you drink it and what you would never order, and your order gets read out loud.

questions.prompt: What your order says about you:

options.label: You have things to do
You have a system
You have taste and a budget
You have decided caffeine is optional

results.name: THE DOUBLE, NO SUGAR
results.blurb: You do not drink coffee, you administer it. Small cup, standing up, no chair, no conversation about the origin. You are efficient to the point of being slightly alarming, and you have a genuine appreciation for a thing done exactly right — you just refuse to make an event of it.
results.watchOut: You treat rest like inefficiency. Sit down with the second one.

results.name: THE FILTER, BLACK
results.tagline: A mug the size of a bowl and a plan for the day
results.blurb: You are a creature of routine and you are happy about it. Same mug, same method, same chair, same time. You like things that improve slowly and quietly, and you are the person who will still be doing this in fifteen years while everyone else cycles through gadgets.
results.watchOut: The routine can become the whole personality. Try one new place this month.

results.name: THE FLAT WHITE
results.tagline: You know exactly what you want and where to get it
results.blurb: You have taste, you have a favourite seat, and you have a barista who knows your name. You are socially fluent, mildly particular and completely unwilling to drink something bad just because it was convenient. Your ideal afternoon is an hour that belongs to nobody else.
results.watchOut: You will walk twenty minutes for the good one. Sometimes the fine one is fine.

results.name: THE ENORMOUS COLD BREW
results.tagline: Iced, absurd, and technically a meal
results.blurb: You are doing a lot and you are doing it at speed. Your coffee is a litre of cold, sweet, mildly terrifying ambition carried in one hand while you answer a message with the other. You are not interested in the ritual. You are interested in getting there.
results.watchOut: You keep adding more instead of stopping. Try one quiet hour.

results.name: THE INSTANT, IN THE GOOD MUG
results.tagline: Kettle on, spoon in, no notes
results.blurb: You have no time for the theatre of coffee and no shame about it. You own one mug that matters, one kettle that works, and a complete indifference to what anybody thinks of your choices. People mock your coffee and then ask you to make them one.
results.watchOut: You accept 'good enough' in more places than the mug. Upgrade one thing.

results.name: THE TURKISH, MADE PROPERLY
results.tagline: Small cup, long process, worth it
results.blurb: You believe a thing done slowly is a thing done right, and you have the patience to prove it. Your kitchen smells of cardamom. You own a small pot for exactly one purpose. You will absolutely not be rushed, and the people who love you have learned to schedule around it.
results.watchOut: Rituals can become excuses. Sometimes the quick cup is the kind one.

results.name: THE MOCHA WITH EVERYTHING
results.tagline: Coffee is a dessert and you've made peace with it
results.blurb: You are here for pleasure, not for productivity, and you refuse to pretend otherwise. Cream, syrup, an unreasonable amount of chocolate: your drink is a small, daily act of self-indulgence. You are also the person who makes everyone else order something they'll enjoy.
results.watchOut: You chase the sweet version of everything. Try the plain one.

results.name: THE DECAF, UNBOTHERED
results.tagline: You ordered it for the ritual, not the rocket fuel
results.blurb: You have opted out of the arms race and you are sleeping beautifully. You like the cup, the pause and the taste, and you have no interest in being wired at 4pm. People treat this as a moral failing. You find their shaking hands quite funny.
results.watchOut: You avoid intensity in more than coffee. Let one thing be strong.
